_doc: Not an asset (files starting with _ are skipped). Grass / ground-cover assets: src/render/vgeo/grass_asset.h documents every key; docs/FOLIAGE_GRASS.md the shading. Densities are clumps per m2 at full density per terrain material (MgMaterial names), x the clumping keep rate (mean about 0.6), x the fidelity level's density, x r_foliage_density.
